_readme: 20 categories x 15+ styles for the Newborn Studio theme gallery. This is content planning only — no images generated yet. Each style has a short 'descriptor' rather than a full prompt; the full Wiro prompt is built at generation time from promptTemplate + category.mood + style.descriptor (see Design/Content/PROMPT_TEMPLATE.md for the exact formula and worked examples). This file is the seed data for the Firestore `ai_models` collection in Phase 6 — nothing here is wired into the app yet.
